## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Arithmetic, timed, twelfth sitting. Ten two-digit multiplications, the sevenths, and 13 squared through 19 squared from memory.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> The interview classic on symmetry and stopping: you flip a fair coin repeatedly. What is the expected number of flips to see HTH? Compare against HHH and say which is longer and why, out loud, without writing the Markov chain.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> A counting problem with structure: how many distinct paths are there from one corner of an 8 by 8 grid to the opposite corner moving only right and up? Then how many stay weakly below the diagonal? Name the second number.
:::
:::
